choices.content: Add all the numbers of transportation options and hotels
Multiply the number of flights by the number of high-speed trains, then add the number of hotels
Add the numbers of transportation options, then multiply by the number of hotels

question.prompt: You first choose transportation, then a hotel. There are two categories of transportation: flights and high-speed trains. How should you count the possibilities?

solutions.explanation: The transportation options are mutually exclusive, so use addition. After choosing transportation, you must also choose a hotel, so use multiplication.
solutions.title: Distinguish alternatives from successive steps
